title: 341 你现在做的每一件事都会在你死前还给你340 肃清第三营
content_zh:
精神力无声探出，瞬间封死了对方全身的动作，肌肉僵住，关节锁死，连一根手指都动弹不得。
就连呼吸也被压到最低，只剩下一丝细细的气流，勉强维持着肺部最基本的起伏。
紧接着，曹笔的精神力再次探入，在那人的肾脏上轻轻捏了一下。
那人的身体猛地一绷，感觉被人从内脏深处捅了一刀，喉结剧烈地上下滚动，可喉咙里连一丝气音都挤不出来。
他的脸瞬间涨红，迅速褪成惨白，额头上青筋暴起，汗珠像被挤出来一样，密密麻麻地铺了一额头。
嘴不受控制地想要张开，想做深呼吸，可是做不到。
少顷。
曹笔的精神力移到了他的胆囊上，轻轻一压。
一种可怕的剧痛从身体最深处炸出来，让他的身体开始疯狂痉挛。
可惜，他被锁死在原地，只能从肌肉深处传来一阵一阵的波浪式颤抖。
在这种状态下，他颈部的青筋一根根暴起，如蚯蚓一样在皮肤下蠕动。
眼中全是血丝，似一张被彻底撑开的网，甚是恐怖。
“这就受不了吗？还没用大招呢！”
曹笔的精神力再一次落下，精准捏住了对方的龙源。
稍稍发力一捏，那人的瞳孔便骤然缩小又骤然放大，眼中的光仿佛突然炸裂了一般，整个人直接失去了神采。
他的身体开始不受控制地剧烈抽搐，可每一次抽搐都会被无形的锁链拽回来，只能抖，不能动，连蜷缩都做不到。
他额头上的汗珠顺着鼻梁滑下来，与眼泪汇成一道细流，无声地滴在地上。
铜壶刻漏！
他的意识开始剥落，似一层一层被人撕下来的皮，先是表层，后是内里，最后连肉带血，都被暴力撕扯了下来。
那种痛已经不是痛了，是一种无边无际的虚无。

身体还在，可身体里的一切都被搅成了碎末。
他想喊，喊不出来。
想动，动不了。
想死，死不成。
唯一剩下的，只有脑海里那些不受控制涌出来的画面，一片一片，带着血腥和眼泪，在他眼前炸开。
第一个画面：黄昏，村口。
他站在破败的土墙后面，怀里抱着一把沾了泥的刀。
前面跪着十几个人，老老少少，男男女女，双手被草绳绑在背后，头低着，不敢抬。
一个小孩在他脚边哭，哭着喊娘。
他没有低头看，抬脚踢了一下，那小孩翻了几个跟头，趴在地上不动了。
紧接着，他走到一个女子跟前，当着众人的面，将刀架在对方脖子上，逼迫对方从了自己。
对方不肯，他便一刀砍了旁边男人的脑袋。
女子恸哭，挣扎着要与他拼命，他狞笑一声，将女子摁在地上，当着众人的面，对其进行惨无人道的蹂躏。
事后，他挥刀砍断女子的四肢，让其流血而死。
第二个画面：月夜，一座废弃的院子内。
十几个人缩在角落里，挤在一起，全是女人。
有些脸是脏的，有些衣裳破了，有些光着脚，脚趾缝里全是泥。
他站在门口，嘴里咬着一块硬饼，慢吞吞地嚼着，目光从那些脸上一个个扫过去。
最后落在一个女人身上，对方坐在最里侧，背靠着墙，双手抱膝，脸埋在膝盖里，看不清表情。
他走过去，站在对方面前，嚼完最后一口饼，咽下去，朝她招了招手，说：“你，来。”
content_en:
The mental power came out silently, instantly blocking the movement of the opponent's whole body. His muscles froze, his joints locked, and he couldn't even move a finger.
Even breathing was suppressed to the lowest level, leaving only a thin stream of air, barely maintaining the most basic ups and downs of the lungs.
Immediately afterwards, Cao Bi's mental power penetrated in again and pinched the man's kidney gently.
The man's body tensed suddenly, and he felt like someone had stabbed him deep in his internal organs. His Adam's apple rolled up and down violently, but not even a breath could be squeezed out of his throat.
His face flushed instantly and quickly faded to pale white. Veins popped up on his forehead, and beads of sweat were densely spread all over his forehead as if they had been squeezed out.
I wanted to open my mouth uncontrollably and take a deep breath, but I couldn't.
A few moments.
Cao Bi's mental power moved to his gallbladder and pressed lightly.
A terrible pain exploded from the deepest part of his body, causing his body to begin to spasm crazily.
Unfortunately, he was locked in place and could only tremble in waves from deep in his muscles.
In this state, the veins on his neck bulged one by one, crawling under his skin like earthworms.
His eyes were full of bloodshot eyes, like a completely opened net, which was very scary.
"Can't you stand this? You haven't even used your ultimate move yet!"
Cao Bi's mental power dropped again, and he accurately grasped the opponent's dragon source.
With a slight squeeze, the man's pupils suddenly shrank and then enlarged. The light in his eyes seemed to explode suddenly, and the whole person lost his energy.
His body began to twitch violently and uncontrollably, but every time he twitched, he would be pulled back by invisible chains. He could only tremble, not move, and couldn't even curl up.
The sweat on his forehead slid down the bridge of his nose and merged with the tears into a thin stream, dripping silently on the ground.
The copper kettle is leaking!
His consciousness began to peel off, like layers of skin being torn off, first the surface, then the inside, and finally even the flesh and blood were violently torn off.
That kind of pain is no longer pain, it is a kind of boundless nothingness.
The body is still there, but everything in the body has been smashed to pieces.
He wanted to shout, but couldn't.
I want to move, but I can't.
I want to die, but I can't.
The only thing left was the images that came out of his mind uncontrollably, one by one, with blood and tears, exploding in front of his eyes.
The first scene: dusk, entrance to the village.
He stood behind the dilapidated earth wall, holding a muddy knife in his arms.
There were more than a dozen people kneeling in front of them, old and young, men and women, their hands tied behind their backs with straw ropes, their heads lowered, not daring to raise them.
A child was crying at his feet, crying for his mother.
Without looking down, he raised his foot and kicked it. The child turned a few somersaults and lay motionless on the ground.
Immediately afterwards, he walked up to a woman, put a knife on her neck in front of everyone, and forced her to obey him.
When the other party refused, he chopped off the man next to him on the head.
The woman cried and struggled to fight him. He laughed ferociously, pushed the woman to the ground, and brutally ravaged her in front of everyone.
Afterwards, he chopped off the woman's limbs with a knife, causing her to bleed to death.
The second scene: a moonlit night, in an abandoned courtyard.
A dozen people huddled together in a corner, all of them women.
Some faces were dirty, some clothes were torn, some had bare feet, and there was mud between their toes.
He stood at the door with a piece of hard biscuit in his mouth, chewing it slowly, and his eyes swept over the faces one by one.
Finally, it landed on a woman. She was sitting at the far end, with her back against the wall, her hands on her knees, her face buried in her knees, and her expression could not be seen clearly.
He walked over, stood in front of her, chewed the last bite of cake, swallowed it, waved to her and said, "Come here."
